name: VOIT: V1 to V4 Visual Cortex Prediction
summary: Research code that reconstructs viewed images from V1 fMRI responses (Vim-1 dataset) by predicting V4 activity with neural networks and decoding it through Stable Diffusion latents; not runnable as a brainlife App.
description: The repository trains an MLP that maps V1 voxel responses to V4 responses, a second model that maps V4 to a PCA-compressed Stable Diffusion latent, and decodes the latent with the Stable Diffusion VAE (optionally refined with img2img); a Streamlit UI (app.py) runs inference. It has no brainlife main script and no registered inputs, outputs or parameters, so it cannot be executed on brainlife.io as registered.
